title: Window chrome (Contacts)
about: The window LumaUI draws around every app, measured on Contacts: frame, radius, shadow and rim, the title row and identity, the window controls at rest, hovered, pressed and focused, an inactive window, a maximized one, and Frost. Only the frame is reported (scope); the app's own content is contacts.json's job.
frame_note: frame: compare the window's own radius, shadow layers and rim, and the frame colour at frame_probes (window coordinates; negative counts from the right or bottom edge).

states.name: active
states.about: The focused window at rest (Priya selected, v70's opening state)

states.name: inactive
states.about: Another window has focus. v70 draws an inactive window exactly as an active one.

states.name: pressed-close
states.about: Close held down (v70 has no pressed rule, so it stays the hover)

states.name: focus-close
states.about: Close focused from the keyboard (v70 :focus-visible, a 2 px accent ring 2 px out)

states.name: identity-menu
states.about: The identity's menu open: v70's own menu (lMenu, .crpop/.crmi) hung from the identity, holding the app's own commands (v70 opens it from Charlie's title; Contacts' rows are the app's). Only the menu's placement and surface are the frame's; its rows are the kit Menu's (K).

states.name: maximized
states.about: Maximized (v70 toggleMax from a double-click on the title row); the desk is sized so the window is the headless monitor, 1920x1200

states.name: frost
states.about: The Frost material (v70 body[data-mat=frost]). Luma's Frost is one light appearance (the kit forces the light scheme), so it is measured against v70's Frost in light.
